And it is our job to inspire them. And so I just think that we out-inspire people again. People are just not participating in the process because they don't feel that their condition will change irrespective of who is elected. And I think there's a big sentiment out there, a wave of attitudes of people just saying, they don't do what they want to do anyway. My one vote doesn't count. And every person needs to realize every single vote counts. And voting, not voting, does have consequences. And we just got to keep pounding that message.
